lessons.title: こんど (kondo) — next time; this time

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Japanese for to shift a time, then the Japanese for to bring forward.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: こんど

segments.text: こんど — kondo — "next time; this time".
こんど じかんが あったら、うちに きて ください。 — kondo jikan ga attara, uchi ni kite kudasai — "Next time you have a moment, please come to my house."

こんど (kondo) is Sino-Japanese (kango): two Chinese characters read with their on'yomi, readings borrowed from Chinese. They are kon, "now" (Middle Chinese kim) and do, "degrees" (duH) (KANJIDIC2; Middle Chinese in Baxter's transcription).
One more word for saying what happens if.

segments.text: こんかい — konkai — "this time; on this occasion".
こんかい まけたら、つぎは がんばります。 — konkai maketara, tsugi wa ganbarimasu — "If we lose this time, we will try harder next time."

こんかい (konkai) is Sino-Japanese (kango): two Chinese characters read with their on'yomi, readings borrowed from Chinese. They are kon, "now" (Middle Chinese kim) and kai, "-times" (hwoj) (KANJIDIC2; Middle Chinese in Baxter's transcription).

lessons.title: ぜんかい (zenkai) — last time; the previous time

blocks.title: You'll want to know: ぜんかい

segments.text: ぜんかい — zenkai — "last time; the previous time".
ぜんかいより はやく ついたら、えきで まって ください。 — zenkai yori hayaku tsuitara, eki de matte kudasai — "If you arrive earlier than last time, please wait at the station."

ぜんかい (zenkai) is Sino-Japanese (kango): two Chinese characters read with their on'yomi, readings borrowed from Chinese. They are zen, "before" (Middle Chinese dzen) and kai, "-times" (hwoj) (KANJIDIC2; Middle Chinese in Baxter's transcription).

じかいの かいぎは、てんきに よります。 — jikai no kaigi wa, tenki ni yorimasu — "Whether the next meeting goes ahead depends on the weather."

じかい (jikai) is Sino-Japanese (kango): two Chinese characters read with their on'yomi, readings borrowed from Chinese. They are ji, "next" (Middle Chinese tshijH) and kai, "-times" (hwoj) (KANJIDIC2; Middle Chinese in Baxter's transcription).

lessons.title: じき (jiki) — a time; a season; a period
lessons.gloss: a time; a season; a period

blocks.title: You'll want to know: じき

segments.text: じき — jiki — "a time; a season; a period".
あつい じきに なったら、みずを のんで ください。 — atsui jiki ni nattara, mizu o nonde kudasai — "When the hot season comes, please drink water."

じき (jiki) is Sino-Japanese (kango): two Chinese characters read with their on'yomi, readings borrowed from Chinese. They are ji, "time" (Middle Chinese dzyi) and ki, "period" (gi) (KANJIDIC2; Middle Chinese in Baxter's transcription).

segments.text: To persuade? (せっとくする, settoku suru.) To urge? (うながす, unagasu.) To ask someone to stay? (ひきとめる, hikitomeru.) As much as possible? (なるべく, narubeku.) For example? (たとえば, tatoeba.) A cause? (げんいん, gen'in.) An influence? (えいきょう, eikyō.) A result? (けっか, kekka.) The reason is? (なぜなら, nazenara.) An attitude? (たいど, taido.) To trust? (しんようする, shin'yō suru.) Confidence? (しんらい, shinrai.) To stand up for? (かばう, kabau.) To be found out? (ばれる, bareru.) To jump to conclusions? (きめつける, kimetsukeru.) A detailed plan? (けいかく, keikaku.) To get things ready? (よういする, yōi suru.) An errand? (ようじ, yōji.) A schedule? (にってい, nittei.) Going smoothly? (じゅんちょう, junchō.) To change a plan? (へんこうする, henkō suru.) To postpone? (えんきする, enki suru.) To cancel? (とりけす, torikesu.) To shift a time? (ずらす, zurasu.) To bring forward? (はやめる, hayameru.) Next time? (こんど, kondo.) On this occasion? (こんかい, konkai.) The previous time? (ぜんかい, zenkai.) The next occasion? (じかい, jikai.) A period of time? (じき, jiki.)

feedback.correct: Right: せっとくする (settoku suru) is 'to persuade'.
feedback.incorrect: 'To persuade' is せっとくする (settoku suru).
